Definition
[Parabolic boundary]

↗ def:parabolic-cylinder-heat-ball

1. ch2:2.3.2-def-2\group Heat Equation

The parabolic boundary is \[ \Gamma _T:=\overline U_T\setminus U_T. \] It consists of $U\times \{ 0\} $ and $\partial U\times [0,T]$, but not the top interior $U\times \{ T\} $.
